Returns identity info for the enclosing pane subtree. Throws [`InvalidOperationException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.invalidoperationexception) when called from a component that isn't rendered inside a docked pane.

```csharp
public static DockPaneInfo UsePane(this RenderContext ctx)
```

An extension method on [`RenderContext`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/components/RenderContext), declared in `DockHooks`. Package: `Microsoft.UI.Reactor.Advanced`. Add `using Microsoft.UI.Reactor.Docking;`.

**Learn more:** [Docking Windows](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/guides/docking)

## Remarks [#remarks]

Spec 045 §5.3.11.
